The '''Fia''' (singular, '''Fian''') were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Galantos]]<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> and adapted to the environment by building [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]]-proof buildings made of the rich ores and minerals mined on the planet. A peaceful species, the Fia communicated through expressive hand and arm gestures, and referred to the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] as "The Multitude."

[[File:Fian_EGTP.png|thumb|left|Fia.]]

During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], the Fia were threatened by the [[Yevetha]] but defended by the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]]. After the crisis, the Fia joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Borsk Fey'lya]] ignored the pleas of the defenseless Fia. Hopeless, the Fia struck a deal with the [[Peace Brigade]] in the hopes of avoiding the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] invaders' wrath. They allowed the Brigade to mine the rich resources from Galantos and voluntarily disabled the Republic communication network, and in exchange the Brigade passed word to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] that the Yevetha were an immediate threat. The Yuuzhan Vong acted on the intelligence and utterly destroyed the Yevetha, but turned their interest to the various species of the Cluster. A mission to Galantos by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to investigate the communications breakdown allowed the Fia to avoid death at the hands of the Yuuzhan Vong.

[[Brabe]] and [[Jobath Knox]] were two famous Fians.
